candidate_set.decision_policy: Always return ABSTAIN with reason_code=BASELINE_NO_PROVIDER; no provider invocation.

candidate_set.tool_use: Functions supported; application remains execution owner
Function calling supported; comparison uses application-owned DecisionSource contract

excluded_current_routes.reason: Same provider/family does not add enough distinct trade-off to justify extra live calls in the minimum comparison; prospective amendment required.
Current Groq docs state Structured Outputs and tool use are not supported together; excluded rather than weakening the strict adapter contract.

population.quality_scope: public deterministic DecisionSource decision-contract probes; not semantic C4/generalization evidence

execution.order_policy: P01..P08; repeats 0..1; alternate live candidate order by unit_index + repeat_index parity; baseline runs locally first with zero provider calls.

M1.name: structured_decision_adherence
M1.denominator: all live provider invocations (16 per candidate)
M1.formula: accepted ProviderDecisionPayload without adapter repair / attempted live invocations

M2.name: known_tool_selection_validity
M2.formula: TOOL decisions whose tool_name is in the frozen 18-operation registry / TOOL decisions

M3.name: canonical_argument_validity_B1_containment
M3.formula: known-tool proposals passing B1 / known-tool proposals; report ARGUMENT_INVALID and identity/seed attempts separately

M4.name: public_allowed_development_task_quality
M4.denominator: all 16 fixed public probe invocations per candidate, including operational failures as 0
M4.formula: invocations satisfying the unit's frozen deterministic decision rubric / 16

M5.name: safe_failure_behavior
M5.denominator: all encountered live provider/client/parsing failures plus one provider-free injected client failure per provider-specific client implementation
M5.formula: safe DECISION_SOURCE_FAILURE + valid provenance + zero unauthorized transport/leakage / failure cases

M7.name: reliability_and_repeat_stability
M7.denominator: 16 live attempts and 8 paired repeat units per candidate

formula.signature_stability: units whose two repeats agree on decision kind and, for TOOL, tool_name / 8

M8.name: usage_resource_cost
M8.denominator: all live attempts with provider-reported usage
M8.formula: report exact provider usage; normalized list-price cost only with exact token usage and frozen price basis; otherwise UNKNOWN

M10.name: trace_integrity
M10.formula: valid provider-model-call-v1 events satisfying ADR-007 / attempted invocations

selection_rule.step_1: Disqualify hard-gate failures and candidates below M1/M4/M5/M7/M10 minimums.
selection_rule.step_2: If no live candidate remains, return NO_SELECTION.
selection_rule.step_3: Compute Pareto non-dominance over M4/M7 maximize and M6 p95/M8 normalized cost minimize.
selection_rule.step_4: If exactly one candidate is Pareto-nondominated, select it.
selection_rule.step_5: If multiple remain, choose highest M4 only if it leads every other remaining candidate by at least 0.125.
selection_rule.step_6: Otherwise within 0.125 M4, prefer lower comparable normalized cost only if chosen stability is not lower by more than 0.125.
selection_rule.step_7: If cost cannot resolve, prefer lower M6 p95 only when both completed all 16 attempts.
selection_rule.step_8: If still unresolved or evidence is incomplete, return NO_SELECTION.

amendment_rules.before_first_live_call: Candidate/population/metric/budget changes require a new manifest version and provider-free validation.
amendment_rules.after_first_live_call: Any material change requires a prospective amendment preserving consumed evidence; changed route/model is a new candidate.

next_authorization: A separate governed live-comparison authorization task is required after this design is frozen. This manifest authorizes zero provider/model calls.
